# harness_platform_authentication_settings (Resource)

Resource for managing account level authentication settings. Destroying this resource resets two-factor authentication, whitelisted domains and public access to the Harness defaults. Session timeout settings are left unchanged, since the API does not expose a way to restore the platform default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage account level authentication settings.
# This is a singleton resource: one instance per Harness account.
resource "harness_platform_authentication_settings" "example" {
  two_factor_enabled               = true
  whitelisted_domains              = ["harness.io", "example.com"]
  session_timeout_minutes          = 60
  absolute_session_timeout_minutes = 480
  public_access_enabled            = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `two_factor_enabled` (Boolean) Whether two-factor authentication is enforced for all users in the account.

### Optional

- `absolute_session_timeout_minutes` (Number) Users are logged out after this many minutes regardless of activity. Maximum: 4320. When not set in the configuration, the current account value is kept (read from the API and sent back on updates, like the Harness UI).
- `public_access_enabled` (Boolean) Whether public access is enabled for the account. When not set in the configuration, the current account value is kept (read from the API, like the Harness UI).
- `session_timeout_minutes` (Number) Users are logged out after this many minutes of inactivity. Valid range: 30 to 4320. When not set in the configuration, the current account value is kept (read from the API and sent back on updates, like the Harness UI).
- `whitelisted_domains` (Set of String) List of whitelisted domains for the account. When not set in the configuration, the current account value is kept (read from the API, like the Harness UI). Set to an empty list to clear all whitelisted domains.

### Read-Only

- `authentication_mechanism` (String) Authentication mechanism configured for the account, e.g. `SSO` or `NON_SSO`.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import account level authentication settings using the account id
terraform import harness_platform_authentication_settings.example <account_id>
```
